updates.title: Updated WTT CommonLib 3.0.8, WTT Content Backport 2.0.7, Epic's AIO 5.0.4, UI Fixes 6.0.4, and Borkel RNVG 3.0.4
updates.summary: All mods were audited and brought to the latest SPT 4.1.6 releases. WTT Content Backport 2.0.7 adds a new BepInEx patcher (WTT-ContentBackportPatcher), Epic's All In One 5.0.4 adds the ProjectRefresh shader plugin (com.epicrangetime.projectrefresh), WTT CommonLib 3.0.8 updates client/Fika/server libraries, UI Fixes 6.0.4 fixes Edit Build weapon body selection, and Borkel's Realistic NVGs 3.0.4 adds C-11 True North NVG profiles.
updates.action: Re-download client-mods.zip (Pack 2026-11-28.2) and extract it into your SPT folder before launching. Older client packs will be rejected by Fika mod verification.

updates.title: Mod verification enabled & Dynamic Maps updated to 1.3.0
updates.summary: Fika server-side mod verification is now active, and Dynamic Maps was updated from 1.2.1 to 1.3.0 (which also adds two Unity Managed DLLs). Clients with missing required mods, unlisted mods, or outdated DLLs will be cleanly rejected on launch instead of crashing in-raid.
updates.action: Re-download client-mods.zip (Pack 2026-11-28.2) and extract it into your SPT folder before launching. Remove any extra mods not listed below.

updates.title: Graceful profile recovery & in-raid reload protection
updates.summary: SPT now strips orphaned modded items/traders from imported profiles on load instead of failing to boot, backs up replaced profiles automatically, and blocks profile imports while anyone is in an active raid.
updates.action: No action needed. Wait until raids finish before importing or replacing a profile.

updates.title: Updated to SPT 4.1.6 and added Questing Bots 1.2.0 + Fika sync
updates.summary: Upgraded SPT from 4.1.5 to 4.1.6 (build 731d7a2) and added the Questing Bots 1.2.0 client plugin and QuestingBotsFikaSync.
updates.action: Ensure your local install is SPT 4.1.6 and uses the current client mod pack.
